newsitem.title: VATICAN: Vatican envoy leaves Rome for Cuba visit.
newsitem.headline: Vatican envoy leaves Rome for Cuba visit.

text.p: Vatican Foreign Minister Jean-Louis Tauran on Friday left Italy for Cuba, a visit that could pave the way for Pope John Paul II to meet President Fidel Castro and also visit the island.
Airport officials said Tauran left Rome's Fiumicino airport at 0630 GMT bound for Havana via Madrid.
Both Roman Catholic Church and government sources say his visit comes amid an improvement in relations between the church and the Communist government.

The five-day visit could prepare for a meeting between Castro and the Pope if the Cuban leader goes to Rome for a World Food Summit organised by the U.N. Food and Agriculture Organisation from November 13 to 17.

Diplomatic sources in Rome have said that if Castro does see the Pope he would probably invite him to Cuba, perhaps next year. The island is the only Latin American country the Pontiff has not visited.
